description: US-based OpenAI-compatible inference provider for language, vision, image, video, and text-to-speech models.
residency_notes: IonRouter is operated by Cumulus Compute Labs in the United States and its privacy policy says the service is operated and data processed in the US. The policy documents request-log retention up to 90 days and generated-content retention up to 30 days; no customer-selectable region or Zero Data Retention control is documented.
prompt_training_notes: IonRouter stores prompts and generated content for limited periods and says request logs and generated content may be reviewed to improve model performance, content safety systems, and the service.

sources.notes: Official API reference, endpoints, model catalog, pricing, and rate limits.
Public live OpenAI-compatible model discovery endpoint.
